svg.text: Traffic Jam: real 12-dose cascade replay (6.85U over 335min, real SMB log)
Pool Compartment: max gap vs conventional = 0.654U (9.6%) at t=197min. TsunamiMods: max gap = 0.557U (8.1%) at t=184min.
tick marks = real SMB dose events. Both forks' own crowding mechanisms are reproduced (Pool Compartment's pooled-mass k1, TsunamiMods' pooled-SC time-warp).
Shaded areas = each fork's own depot/SC-tissue mass, the quantity its crowding calculation is actually driven by (not just its downstream effect on IOB).
